standard: EN 16931-1 semantic model, business terms and groups
edition: EN 16931-1:2017+A1:2019 (baseline of this package). The edition EN 16931-1:2026 was approved on 2026-03-13, replaces it and is not backward compatible (one source says BT-10 changes from 1..1 to 0..n and BT-29 and BT-46 from 1..n to 0..n). Which edition the package targets is an open decision (18, Q in CHANGELOG)

source.title: EN 16931 business rules BR-01 to BR-65 and BR-CO-xx as published in the Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 specification, section 16.2
source.note: Secondary source: the rules are those of EN 16931, the page is paraphrased by the fetch tool. The normative text is EN 16931-1, which is not freely available. Term names are those of the standard

scope: The terms of an invoice or credit note that order management builds (sales_invoice, 12, 10). Not covered: allowances and charges, invoicing period, attachments, tax representative, payee, classification identifiers, item attributes
requirement: MANDATORY: a business rule requires the term in every invoice. CONDITIONAL: required under a stated condition. OPTIONAL otherwise. Derived from the BR rules named in the note column
statuses: MAPPED: a core column. DERIVED: computed from core data. PROFILE: set by the syntax profile of the app (CIUS). GAP: not held by the core. OMITTED: optional and not produced
note: App content (12, 10). The core produces the data set with the business term identifiers as keys, an app writes the syntax (UBL, CII) and applies the CIUS. The completeness check of the data set (12, 10) uses the MANDATORY and CONDITIONAL terms of this file: the core's own list is the one in force until the core reads the package, see the CHANGELOG
